say.guildmark.trade_board_0: New tickets are up. Fair pay for honest carriers.
say.guildmark.trade_board_1: Fresh word from the other towns, chalked and stamped.
say.guildmark.trade_board_2: Mind the dates on the tickets. They don't keep.
say.guildmark.trade_board_first_0: The morning's word is up. Come and read it.
say.guildmark.trade_board_first_1: Good morning to the carriers. The board is chalked.
say.guildmark.trade_tally_0: Here. It remembers what you see and what you carry.
say.guildmark.trade_tally_1: Keep it dry. Every carrier needs a Tally.
say.guildmark.trade_report_0: Your word is good. I'll chalk it up.
say.guildmark.trade_book_0: Stamped and sealed. It's yours to fill.
say.guildmark.trade_book_1: Booked. Mind the day it falls due.
say.guildmark.trade_lapsed_0: That ticket has lapsed. It's back on the board.
say.guildmark.trade_lapsed_1: You never brought the goods. Another will.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_harness_0: A good harness, and a whistle to call them by.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_harness_1: Sound straps. Your beast will thank you.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_harness_2: Fit that snug and she'll follow you anywhere.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_donkey_0: Here's a donkey, tame and willing.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_donkey_2: She's yours. Be kind to her and she'll carry all day.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_cart_0: A fine cart. Mind the wheels on the stones.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_cart_1: Light enough to pull, big enough to matter.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_cart_2: Pull it with pride. It carries your name now.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_wagon_0: The seal is on the bill. The wagon is yours.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_wagon_1: A wagon of your own at last. Drive it well.
say.guildmark.trade_sell_wagon_2: Mind the road, and keep your guards close.
say.guildmark.trade_warrant_0: By the hall's leave, a carrier of good name.
say.guildmark.trade_warrant_2: The hall trusts you with the big loads.
say.guildmark.trade_delivered_0: Just what we were short of.
say.guildmark.trade_delivered_1: Counted and sound. Here's your pay.
say.guildmark.trade_delivered_2: That'll keep the shelves full. Thank you.
say.guildmark.trade_delivered_3: Good carrying. We'd have run dry by the week's end.
say.guildmark.trade_relief_0: Bless you. We were running out.
say.guildmark.trade_relief_1: You've kept us fed. We won't forget it.
say.guildmark.trade_part_0: That's a start. Bring the rest by the day.
say.guildmark.trade_part_1: Some now and more later? That'll do for the moment.
say.guildmark.trade_street_0: Bless the road that brought it.
say.guildmark.trade_street_1: The carriers have done us proud.
say.guildmark.trade_firstcall_0: I'd sooner deal with you again. Take it first, if you'll have it.
say.guildmark.trade_firstcall_1: Same again, if you can. You'll have first call.
say.guildmark.crier_hauls_0: Carriers are wanted at the Haul Board!
say.guildmark.crier_hauls_1: Goods wanted from the road! See the Haul Board!
say.guildmark.crier_hauls_2: Carriers wanted! Fair pay at the Haul Board!
say.guildmark.crier_hauls_thanks: Our thanks to those who brought goods in from the road!
say.guildmark.crier_hauls_bells: Bells on the road! The carriers are about!
say.guildmark.crier_house: A trading house is running wagons to us!
say.guildmark.trade_passing_0: Mind how you go with that.
say.guildmark.trade_passing_1: Heavy load! Keep to the road, friend.
say.guildmark.trade_cartman_1: Mind the shafts. She's a good one.
say.guildmark.trade_hold_0: Hold there! Drop the pack and no one bleeds!
say.guildmark.trade_hold_1: Stand where you are! Leave the load and walk on!
say.guildmark.trade_hold_2: That's far enough! Put the goods down!
say.guildmark.trade_wise_1: Sensible. Stand still and it'll be quick.
say.guildmark.trade_lost_1: Gone to ground. Back to the camp.
say.guildmark.trade_flee_0: Off, off! There's too many of them!
say.guildmark.trade_guard_hello_0: Guard at your service. I'll keep close.
say.guildmark.trade_guard_stay_1: Get back, I'll deal with them!
say.guildmark.trade_guard_end_0: My days are up. Good road to you.
say.guildmark.trade_guard_end_1: That's my time served. Hire me again if you like.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_hello_0: Welcome to the Store. Your goods are safe with me.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_hello_1: Morning. The bonded goods are all in order.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_hello_2: Anything to leave, or to take away?
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_bonded_0: Bonded, and sealed for the month.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_bonded_1: Safe in the Store. They keep their name a month.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_unpaid_0: My wage is owing. I can't bond more until it's paid.
say.guildmark.trade_clerk_unpaid_1: The Store is shut to new goods till I'm paid.
say.guildmark.trade_scribe_back_1: A wagon in the yard! I'll count it.
say.guildmark.trade_scribe_back_2: Back safe, and the strongbox heavier.
say.guildmark.trade_scribe_float_0: We're short of float. The wagons can't load.
say.guildmark.trade_scribe_float_1: The strongbox is nearly empty. Put something in.
say.guildmark.trade_carter_hired_0: I'll drive for you, and gladly.
say.guildmark.trade_carter_hired_1: A good wage and a good wagon. Done.
say.guildmark.trade_carter_back_1: Safe home. The road was kind.
say.guildmark.trade_carter_robbed_0: They stopped us on the road. I'm sorry.
say.guildmark.trade_carter_robbed_1: Outlaws took the load. I did what I could.
say.guildmark.trade_gate_house_0: That's a House wagon. Let it through.
say.guildmark.trade_gate_house_1: A trading house on the road. Good to see it.
